map.航站楼容量评估采用「瓶颈资源法」：分别计算安检通道、值机柜台、登机口各环节的处理: Terminal capacity assessment uses the bottleneck-resource method: compute the upper processing capacity of each stage (security lanes, check-in counters, boarding gates) as single-resource rate × number of resources, take the minimum across stages as the theoretical peak-hour passenger ceiling, and allow for queuing buffer and staff proficiency factors. All calculations run locally in the browser and no data is uploaded.
map.📚 深度解析：航站楼（容量/安检）评估: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Terminal Capacity and Security Check Assessment
map.新建或改扩建航站楼时，按总面积、安检通道、值机柜台、登机口数，估算高峰小时可服务: When building or expanding a terminal, estimate the peak-hour passenger ceiling from the total area, security lanes, check-in counters and boarding gates.
map.找出瓶颈资源（如安检通道不足），指导增开通道或调整排班。: Identify the bottleneck resource (such as insufficient security lanes) to guide opening more lanes or adjusting rosters.
map.给定高峰小时旅客数，反算需要的安检/值机资源，做人员与设备预算。: Given the peak-hour passenger count, back-calculate the required security/check-in resources for staffing and equipment budgets.
map.中型航站楼容量测算: Capacity estimate for a medium terminal
map.总面积 40000 m²、安检通道 12 条、值机柜台 40 个、登机口 25: Total area 40000 m², 12 security lanes, 40 check-in counters, 25 boarding gates and 6000 peak passengers/hour. If one lane handles 150 people/hour, the security ceiling is 12×150=1800 people/hour, well below the passenger volume, so security is the bottleneck and more lanes or staggered peaks are needed.
map.容量和吞吐量有什么区别？: What is the difference between capacity and throughput?
map.容量是理论上限（资源×单资源处理能力），吞吐量是实际通过量，受流程、人员熟练度、: Capacity is the theoretical ceiling (resources × per-resource handling rate), while throughput is the actual passing volume, usually below capacity because of process, staff proficiency and passenger behaviour. Assess with the minimum over bottleneck resources and leave a margin.
map.为什么算出来总不够用？: Why does the computed figure always seem insufficient?
map.常因只算了硬件（柜台数）没算单点处理时间，或未考虑值机—安检—登机的串行等待。建: Often because only the hardware (number of counters) was counted without the per-point processing time, or because the serial waiting of check-in, security and boarding was not considered. Compute the ceiling of each stage, take the minimum and add a queuing buffer.
map.航站楼容量评估参考MH/T 5018《民用机场航站楼设计规范》: Terminal capacity assessment references MH/T 5018, Code for Design of Civil Airport Terminals
map.人均面积标准15m²，安检通道180人/小时，值机柜台60人/小时: Area standard 15 m² per person, security lane 180 people/hour, check-in counter 60 people/hour
map.容量瓶颈为各环节最小通过能力: The capacity bottleneck is the smallest throughput among the stages
map.利用率超过80%应启动流程优化，超过95%需考虑扩建: Start process optimisation above 80% utilisation and consider expansion above 95%
map.高峰小时旅客数通常为日旅客量的8-12%: Peak-hour passengers are usually 8-12% of the daily passenger volume
